text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Mayano-chan, thanks for today!
I'll be taking notes on your outfit picks!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me☆ It was for your social media stream, right?
I'll teach you all about head-over-heels coord styling♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Mayano-chan went out of her way to help me.
I'm definitely going to pick out great clothes...!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Woah, that shirt is so sparkly~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see, it's a new shirt!
Keeping up with the latest trends is a must, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah! New things are super sparkly and cute just by being new☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"New things are sparkling"... I see.
New releases are cutting-edge fashion, after all. That's good to know!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahem☆ Maya also really likes
bright and cute colors!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What's important is using a base color that suits you!
Then, you add a sharp accent color for flair☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
For Tarumae-chan~ maybe something bluish?
The outfit you're wearing right now looks great on you too☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Blue tones...! Oh right, I have cool undertones,
so... Thank you, Mayano-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'll pick one out using what you taught me.
It might take a while though...
Could you wait for me at a café or somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Maya will be at the 1st floor cafe then!
Good luck☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, over here, over here~!
Did you pick out your outfit? What kind did you go with?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I-It's... here...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hm??

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It didn't work at all~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I thought about trying out the trendy bare-shoulder look,
but that would stray too far from the pure-and-cute vibe—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I try to think of a cute, pure blue outfit,
it just ends up looking like what I always wear...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, after thinking this and that, I ended up not being able to pick anything...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see~...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Mayano-chan...! After you went
out of your way to teach me so much, I—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehe☆ Maya figured out the right answer♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why do you think the fans
come to watch my 'private streams'?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
? ...Umm, is that...
because there are things you can only see there?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Unlike a live concert or TV, there are things
that can only be shown through a live stream—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So, what outfit should I pick today~?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Mayano-chan! Could you help me pick out
a mature-cute dress!?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"A side of me you don't usually see"—
That's what I want to show everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, of course!
Maya will pick out the super-cutest one and turn you into a mature local idol☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: “—And so, Mayano helped pick out this navy blue one-piece dress for me!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a break in the trainer's office,
Hokko Tarumae told me about what happened on her day off.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
Mayano-chan really is amazing after all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's my worries or picking out clothes...
whenever Mayano-chan steps in,
it gets solved in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're always looking out for me...
So kind.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that dress is hanging on my wall
right now! Look!
choice_data_list: Since they took the time to pick it out for you, maybe you should wear it...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that dress is hanging on my wall
right now! Look!
choice_data_list: Since they took the time to pick it out for you, maybe you should wear it...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Mayano-chan really has amazing fashion sense!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the shape of this top so stylish!
This is where the "mature and cute" appeal comes from♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I'm so glad. I hope I can go shopping with Mayano-chan again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Hokko Tarumae speak so happily brought a warm smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that may be true, but...
It just feels like such a waste!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
At least—at the very least!
I'd like to hold off on wearing it until the next time I can go out with Mayano-chan, you see~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We've drifted quite far from our original goal of buying clothes for streaming...
but she looks so happy, so I decide to keep quiet and let her be.
